summary: Verified new 'Add section from template' feature on Meetings page for both upcoming[0] and past[0]. All three template types (Description, Recording, Decisions Made) add correctly, editable inputs use path-based data-testids, remove buttons work, empty sections are hidden in view mode, filled sections render (Description as paragraph, Recording as 'View recording' link with target=_blank and correct href), data persists to backend GET /api/content and survives hard reload. Regression checks passed: Teams scheduler, Purpose/Agenda, existing Decisions Made / Action Items fields on past meetings, and attach-document flow (upcoming-meeting-0-attachment-upload) all still render. Cleaned up all test sections after run (backend now shows sections: []).
critical_code_review_comments: MeetingSections.idx lookup uses sections.findIndex on each render which is O(n^2); acceptable for tiny lists but consider mapping with the natural index from the visible loop when editMode=false may have shuffled visibility. Currently correct because idx is computed from the full sections array.
seed_data_creation: Added and later removed test sections on meetings.upcoming[0] and meetings.past[0]. Final state: sections=[] on both.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully functional. Note: inner_text() reflects CSS 'uppercase' transform, so string checks for label text like 'Decisions Made' will fail-match against 'DECISIONS MADE'; use case-insensitive comparison in future.
